params.body:
Ask sat 1px lower than Studio in the header.

The Ask button spread the shared link style (which has `borderBottom: 2px`) and then set `border: 'none'`. The key `borderBottom` already existed earlier in the object, so the shorthand came after it and removed the bottom edge: the button was 32px tall against the link's 34px, centred in the same row. It now clears only the other three sides. Measured: both 34px tall, text at the same top.
params.title: Header: Ask and Studio on one line
